parsed.post: Discarding the DEPTH=8 run (val_bpb 1.0577); it seems increasing depth with a high MATRIX_LR of 0.11 caused significant instability and regression. Reverting to my best (75f3985, val_bpb 1.044486). I will now revert to a more stable MATRIX_LR=0.08 at DEPTH=6 to regain baseline performance.
parsed.description: Reverting to the last known stable configuration (DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.08) after the depth-8 expansion failed due to instability.
